Markets.title: Milky Mist Dairy Food shares slip 4% after sharp post-listing rally
Markets.summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food shares dropped 4% due to profit-booking following a 42% surge over their first two trading sessions. Analysts warned investors against buying the stock at its current premium valuation despite the company's strong revenue growth and market position.

Markets.title: Muthoot Finance, Manappuram, other gold financier stocks jump up to 4% as gold prices rise above Rs 1.58 lakh/10 grams
Markets.summary: Shares of gold loan companies like Muthoot Finance and Manappuram Finance rose up to 4% following a surge in gold prices. Higher gold prices increase the value of the collateral pledged against loans for these financiers.

Markets.title: Samsung Electroncis to announce more than $72 billion shareholder return programme: Report
Markets.summary: Samsung Electronics plans a shareholder return program exceeding 100 trillion won following record profits driven by the AI chip supercycle. The company will allocate 50 percent of its free cash flow to this new program, which will be submitted for board approval later this month.

Markets.title: Shiprocket shares jump 6% as Goldman Sachs acquires Rs 53 crore stake. Time to buy or book profits?
Markets.summary: Goldman Sachs bought a Rs 52.7 crore stake in Shiprocket through a bulk deal, driving the company's shares up by 6%. Analysts advise current investors to book partial profits and recommend that new buyers wait for price dips.

Markets.title: US Stock Market: Treasury steps in to curb rising long-duration bond yields
Markets.summary: The US Treasury has doubled its planned buybacks of longer-dated bonds to at least $4 billion per operation. This action aims to ease liquidity pressures after the 30-year Treasury yield reached its highest level since 2007.

Markets.title: Rupee rises 17 paise to 95.56 against US dollar in early trade
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened by 17 paise to 95.56 against the US dollar in early Thursday trade. This movement was driven by a decline in the dollar index following the US Treasury's unexpected plan to increase bond buybacks and reduced expectations of Federal Reserve tightening.

Geo-Political.title: Australia 'outraged' after Israeli decision not to prosecute over killing of aid worker in Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: Australia expressed outrage and summoned the Israeli ambassador after Israel decided not to prosecute anyone for the killing of aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza. Foreign Minister Penny Wong called the decision insulting and unacceptable.

Geo-Political.title: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
Geo-Political.summary: The founder of the collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande has been sentenced to life in prison. This sentencing marks a key moment in the fallout from the company's collapse, which shook China's property sector.

Geo-Political.title: Russia launches missile strikes on Kyiv and surrounding region, killing at least eight
Geo-Political.summary: On Thursday, Russia launched a massive missile attack targeting apartment blocks and warehouses in Kyiv and the surrounding region. The strikes killed at least eight people, according to the State Emergency Service of Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Trump threatens 'tremendous economic consequences' on any country helping Iran
Geo-Political.summary: Former President Trump threatened severe economic consequences against any nation that aids Iran following the expiration of a 60-day ceasefire. The warning comes as the conflict continues without any diplomatic or military resolution.

Geo-Political.title: Giant whales move into Greenland waters as ice disappears
Geo-Political.summary: Climate change is melting sea ice and opening Greenland waters. This has allowed giant whales to move into the area for feeding frenzies.

Geo-Political.title: Former Liberian vice president charged in drug-trafficking probe
Geo-Political.summary: Former Liberian Vice President Jewel Howard-Taylor has been charged with illegally facilitating, importing, and selling drugs. She also faces additional charges of money laundering in connection with the drug-trafficking probe.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without using paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates a shift in organic traffic from traditional search engine optimization to AI optimization.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. The currency's fate depends on whether inflows from RBI deposits enter the open market or are absorbed as reserves.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated in the August MPC minutes that the central bank requires clear evidence of persistent inflation before taking action. Consequently, the rate-setting panel has signaled potential future policy tightening if high prices continue.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — Unpacking the economics of India's toll landscape, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highways Management Company reveals how high-volume corridors, changing private sector involvement, and FASTag annual passes shape highway revenues. These factors together drive the overall economic model of India's toll road landscape.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research raised India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%. However, ongoing downside risks include the West Asia war, high inflation, a depreciating currency, and weaker-than-expected capital expenditure.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is accelerating agricultural spending and fertilizer outlays. This financial push aims to protect rural incomes and consumption from the negative impacts of El Nino and a weak monsoon.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research expects India to achieve a $50 billion balance of payments surplus in fiscal year 2027. This projected surplus is driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

India.title: IIM Bangalore Opens Admissions For BSc (Hons) Programmes In Data Sciences And Economics
India.summary: IIM Bangalore has opened admissions for its BSc (Hons) programmes in Data Sciences and Economics. The programmes offer a total of 80 seats, divided equally between the two fields, on the IIM Bangalore campus.

India.title: In A Tit-For-Tat Move, New Delhi Removes Encroachments Outside Pak High Commission
India.summary: New Delhi removed encroachments outside the Pakistani High Commission. This action was taken three days after Pakistani authorities removed security barricades outside the Indian High Commission in Islamabad.

India.title: Congress Firm On 2-Stanza Vande Mataram, BJP Calls Party "Muslim League"
India.summary: The Congress Working Committee decided to limit party events to the first two stanzas of Vande Mataram, adhering to a 1937 resolution. In response, the BJP criticized the decision and labeled the Congress party the "Muslim League."

India.title: 100 Murder Cases Shifted From UP Judge Who Sentenced 22 To Death In 4 Months
India.summary: An Indian judge in Uttar Pradesh sentenced 22 individuals to death across 10 cases in four months. Following this, authorities shifted 100 pending murder cases away from his court.

India.title: "Even Your Father Can't...": Minister's Daughter Dares Revanth Reddy, Exposes Party Rift
India.summary: A minister's daughter challenged Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy after he publicly backed a sitting MLA. She demanded that the MLA resign immediately and contest a new election rather than wait two years.

India.title: Meet 13-Year-Old Aniket Sarkar, 3M Young Scientist Who Captures Water From Dry Air
India.summary: Thirteen-year-old Aniket Sarkar was named a 3M Young Scientist for developing a device that captures water from dry air. Inspired by 3D printing, he plans to become an environmental engineer to address climate challenges and improve water solutions.

General.title: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK later this month
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are moving back to the United Kingdom later this month. Their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, are enrolled to start school in September.

General.title: Harry and Meghan are experts in surprise - but is their UK return forever?
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have made a sudden return to the UK. This unexpected visit raises new questions for both the couple and the Royal Family.

General.title: Russia launches missile strikes on Kyiv and surrounding region, killing at least eight
General.summary: Russia launched massive missile strikes targeting apartment blocks and warehouses in Kyiv and the surrounding region on Thursday. The attacks killed at least eight people, according to the State Emergency Service of Ukraine.

General.title: Giant whales move into Greenland waters as ice disappears
General.summary: Melting sea ice from climate change has opened up the region for giant whales to undertake "feeding frenzies".

General.title: Vaccine breakthrough stops cancer returning in trial
General.summary: A new jab extended the length of time patients were cancer free, but it is unclear for how long.

General.title: Downpours to continue for UK with risk of flash flooding
General.summary: Heavy and thundery showers are sweeping across the UK, ending the recent prolonged dry spell. These downpours bring an ongoing risk of flash flooding to the region.
